dict.string: LogiHide sees which of your paired Bluetooth devices are connected, to show audio output status and support automation rules and accessory alerts. It never connects to a device, scans for devices or sends anything to one.
LogiHide shows your next events and their meeting links in the notch hub. It reads them on this Mac only and never sends or stores them.
LogiHide watches your Downloads folder for downloads in progress, to show them at the notch. It never reads what you download.
LogiHide reads the name of the Wi-Fi network you are connected to, to show network status and support your automation rules. It does not read your location.
